w: Players keep what they earned now; nothing is lost while those features are built.

q: Turn on real address forwarding for Bedrock players so the AFK IP rule works for them?
w: Otherwise every Bedrock player shares one address and only one of them could earn.

q: Let the plugin send the resource pack, leaving server.properties empty?
w: The plugin can send per-player versions and handle the forced prompt and failures.

q: Keep the resource pack in a resourcepack folder inside this repository?
w: One place for code and pack, so item ids and models never drift apart.

q: Build our own small Bedrock converter for icons, glyphs and sounds?
w: Ready-made converters miss our menus and glyphs; a small one fits exactly.

q: Keep the vanilla look for Depths drops except voidstone, raider scrap and wither ash?
w: Saves your drawing time for crates, menus, sets and tools, where custom looks matter most.

q: Change a tool's model by tier only, with a prestige spark and no change per level?
w: About 35 models instead of hundreds, and every tier still looks different.

q: Keep the check, cross, star and hourglass symbols as plain Unicode, not pack pictures?
w: They already look good on Java and Bedrock and need no art.

q: Use a custom world border texture for the whole server?
w: The island border is seen all the time; a phoenix border is a cheap, visible win.

q: Leave the player-inventory half of menus unpainted by the pack?
w: Painting it clashes with players' own items and doubles the art work.

q: If the forced pack fails to download, let the player in on the vanilla look and alert staff?
w: A broken pack host must never lock every player out of the server.

q: Include custom worn armor looks for sets on Java in the first pack release?
w: Sets are a big part of progression; seeing them on players sells them.

q: Draw one Set Token texture per tier (4) instead of one per set (16)?
w: Tokens are short-lived items; four textures save a lot of drawing.

q: Draw one blueprint texture per rarity (2) instead of one per blueprint (4)?
w: The blueprint name already says which one it is.

q: Draw 5 pilot pieces first and check them in game before drawing the rest?
w: Catches style or size problems before you spend hours on the full set.

q: Wait with the donor rank badges until the final rank names and colors are set?
w: Badges drawn for the old names would have to be redrawn.

q: The island earns 1 fuel minute per minute while at least one member is active on it (not 1 per member)?
w: Otherwise a team of 5 makes 5x the fuel and AFK production runs away (risk R5).

q: Only active time on your own island earns fuel (an action in the last 15 min); standing AFK on the island burns fuel, and The Depths earns none?
w: The AFK pool is the only AFK reward (your rule 9); this answers the old M3.0 question too.

q: Fuel tank 12 h at start, +2 h per Fuel Tank level, 36 h at level 12?
w: Covers a weekend away late in the season without making offline the main income.

q: Fuel Cells (1 h / 3 h / 6 h) from crates, calendar, battle pass, rank kits and the island shop are bound to the profile and can't be traded?
w: If fuel could be bought from other players, money would buy production hours.

q: One fuel tank runs the main island and all its outposts (outposts burn no extra fuel)?
w: Simple to understand; outposts are already priced as late projects.

q: Generator table: 11 levels from cobblestone to emerald plus two custom ores (Ashstone $180, Emberite $396), newest ore 5% per level?
w: Your answer V4 (vanilla ores + 2 custom), prices from the balance sheet.

q: Generator ores must be mined by hand (no drills or auto-miners in Phase 7)?
w: Keeps generators active play; offline income comes from crops and spawners.

q: Generator ores give Mining pillar XP at 25% of the Depths ore, but no Mining skill XP?
w: Skills stay Depths-driven (M4.5), but the island still sees its generator.

q: Area enchants (Vein Rend and friends) don't break real island blocks; island generator ores still roll books at 25%?
w: Area breaking of real blocks is a grief and lag risk on islands.

q: Planting unlocks by Farming level as in WORLD 5.1 (wheat 0, carrot/potato 5 ... pitcher plant 58), seeds in /shop locked the same way?
w: Same ladder as the Depths tiers, so farming has its own progression.

q: Farming XP only for ripe crops broken with a hoe; bone-mealed crops give drops but no XP, books or set XP?
w: Stops bone-meal XP farming; the wardrobe already uses the hoe rule.

q: Fully custom crops with their own models wait for the resource pack; Phase 7 has the 11 vanilla crop tiers plus Golden crops?
w: Custom models need the pack; the rules are custom already.

q: Harvester hoe area by tool level: 3x3 from level 1, 5x5 at level 15, 7x7 at level 30 (Wide Reap up to 9x9)?
w: Matches your V6 answer with the tool level steps players already know.

q: 11 hoe tiers (one per crop tier) and 12 rod tiers (one per fishing tier), forged with money plus crops/fish of the tier before?
w: Same Forge rules as pickaxes and axes.

q: Chunk Collector storage 5k / 20k / 80k / 320k / 1.28M items by tier, and it catches 60 / 70 / 80 / 90 / 100% of offline output?
w: Merging gives more storage and faster pickup (DESIGN); the offline share also guards against AFK income.

q: Auto-sell Chest sells every 10 / 5 / 2 / 1 / 0.5 min by tier at the dynamic price, and also sells from a Chunk Collector in the same chunk?
w: Lets a farm sell itself without hoppers (you said no filter hoppers).

q: Auto-sell money goes to the island bank with island sell bonuses only (no personal rank or booster bonus)?
w: Production belongs to the island; personal bonuses need a player selling.

q: One Chunk Collector and one Auto-sell Chest per chunk?
w: A collector covers its whole chunk; two would fight over the same drops.

q: Merge by right-clicking a placed collector with another of the same kind and tier, then confirm; contents are kept?
w: One click, works on Bedrock, nothing is lost.

q: Every new island gets one bound tier 1 Chunk Collector at the tutorial finish (can't be traded or merged)?
w: Without it, a casual player's offline income depends on crate luck.

q: A full collector stops picking up; items stay on the ground as stacks (and despawn) and members get one warning per hour?
w: You said no collector overflow into storage; the warning tells players to sell.

q: Offline without a collector: crops ripen and spawner mobs pile up in their stacks (max 8 stacks x 1,024 per type per chunk) for you to kill when you return?
w: Coming back has value and rewards playing; collectors turn it into items.

q: Offline output gives no skill, tool or set XP and no books; offline crops give 25% Farming pillar XP, offline spawners no Combat pillar XP?
w: XP and books must come from playing, not from fuel.

q: Basic fishing (skill, rods, loot, custom fish, rod enchants, fishing sets) comes in Phase 7; sea creatures, lava fishing and contests stay in Phase 8?
w: The Fishing skill, E6 and the fishing sets all wait for it.

q: Fishing pays about 60% of The Depths per active hour (plus crystals, books and Tide Chests)?
w: A relaxed option that never replaces The Depths as main income.

q: Fishing loot: 70% fish, 15% junk, 10% treasure, 5% rare fish (5x value), and 1 in 4,000 a Phoenix key fragment?
w: Keeps catches exciting; the key fragment chance is tiny.

q: Fishing anti-AFK: after 40 catches in the same spot without moving 8 blocks, catches give only junk and no XP; custom loot only with a custom rod?
w: Stops AFK fishing machines without bothering real anglers.

q: Fishing works on islands, outposts and marked spawn ponds, not in The Depths or the warzone?
w: Fishing belongs to the island side of the game.

q: Outposts unlock with the Outpost Slots upgrade once all pillars reach 10 / 25 / 40; Wildwood uses Combat pillar 30 instead of 'first world boss' until bosses exist, Emberdeep needs a member at Depths combat tier 10?
w: Bosses come in Phase 8; outposts should not wait for them.

q: Outposts share the island's roles, bank, fuel and settings, and are reached from the island menu and the Outposts portal at spawn (no new command)?
w: One island with extra land; menus work on Bedrock.

q: Biomes: one active biome per outpost, tiers I-V give +5% each (+25% at V), Fusion I/II merge at 75% each, every effect inside the existing bonus caps?
w: Felt but small; caps keep the +300% sell rule and crop growth cap safe.

q: Soul Sand Valley (boss key chance) shows 'Coming soon' until bosses exist?
w: Its effect has nothing to work on before Phase 8.

q: The main island biome changer is cosmetic only and free (any biome from a list) in the Biomes menu?
w: Your FI 15 yes; effects belong to outposts (DESIGN 3.8).

q: New sub-command /is production (fuel, collectors, generator, crops, spawners, last offline report)?
w: Players check fuel often; also a button in the island menu.

q: Staff commands /isadmin fuel <player> add|set <minutes>, /isadmin production <player> and /collector give <player> <kind> <tier>, all audited?
w: Staff need to fix fuel after bugs and judge AFK reports; give works like /spawner give.

q: Balance rule: an island's whole output per production hour stays below 40% of the same player's Depths income per active hour, generator mining below 25%?
w: Turns 'production never beats The Depths' into a number the model checks.

q: New island role keys collectors (break, merge, take out, sell; Leader, Admin, Mod), outposts and biomes (Leader, Admin)?
w: Collectors hold the island's money; leaders decide who touches them.

q: In shared combat zones, the player who did the most damage gets a normal mob's rewards (not the last hit)?
w: Stops kill stealing in busy zones; normal mobs die in ~2.5 s, so assists don't need rewards.

q: Combat tiers 1-3 have no mob abilities; tiers 4-10 one ability per mob type, mini-bosses two, every ability warned 1 s before it hits?
w: Tiers 1-3 stay safe for new players (WORLD 4.4); the warning makes abilities fair on Bedrock too.

q: 2% of tier 4+ mobs spawn as elites (2x health, +1 ability, 3x drops, a star before the name), counted inside the normal money per kill?
w: Adds surprise without raising combat income above the mine.

q: Mini-bosses get two abilities, stay leashed to their ring and also drop 1-2 summon fragments to everyone with 10%+ damage?
w: Makes mini-bosses real fights and the main source of summon fragments.

q: World boss every 2 hours from 12:00 to 00:00 Oslo time (7 a day), announced 5 min before?
w: Most players can join one in an evening session; WORLD 4.5 already says 5 min warning.

q: The boss arena opens only during a fight, for players with Combat 12+, through /bosses, the Gate event board and the tier 10 portal?
w: The tier 10 portal alone would leave the boss to late-game players; Combat 12 keeps total beginners out.

q: World boss health is set from the fighters' sword tiers when the 60 s join window closes (aim: about 5 minutes), and it escapes after 10 minutes?
w: The fight lasts about the same with 10 or 150 players.

q: Reward bands: top 3, Gold (150%+ of the average damage), Silver (50%+), Bronze (10%+), so they work for any number of fighters?
w: Fixed percentages break with 150 fighters (1% each); relative bands stay fair.

q: Anti-leech: rewards only if you are in the arena at the kill, hit the boss in the last 90 s, are not AFK, reach Bronze, and max 3 accounts per IP?
w: Stops AFK alts in the arena from farming boss loot.

q: World boss money in minutes of your own tier's reference income: Bronze 3, Silver 6, Gold 10 min, top 3 get +10 / +7 / +5 min?
w: Feels the same on day 1 and in month 3 and keeps bosses inside the event share.

q: World boss shards: top 3 get 20 / 15 / 10, Gold 5, Silver 3, Bronze 1?
w: Keeps the balance sheet's top-3 numbers; bands replace 'everyone with 1%+ damage gets 3'.

q: Set XP from world bosses by band: Gold 1,500, Silver 1,000, Bronze 500 (instead of 1,500 for 5%+ damage)?
w: With 100+ fighters almost nobody reaches 5% of the damage.

q: Launch with two world bosses (Iron Colossus, The Hollow King); Wyrm of the Deep comes with the resource pack?
w: The Wyrm needs a custom model; the other two work with scaled vanilla bodies on Bedrock.

q: Boss points (100 x your share of the damage per fight, top 3 bonus) fill the Hall of Heroes boss board per season and per week, using your best profile?
w: Raw damage favours whoever fights most often in big fights; share points are fair across fight sizes.

q: Each world boss has two boss-only blueprints (1-3% chance by band)?
w: Phase 4 promised blueprints from bosses; they give a reason to keep fighting late in the season.

q: Five summon bosses, one per two combat tiers (Rotfather, Bog Matriarch, Tide Witch, Pyre Marshal, Ashen Tyrant)?
w: Every stage of the Depths has a boss to work toward.

q: Summon fragments drop 1 in 150 kills in their tier band plus from mini-bosses; 8 fragments + money make a sigil at a Summoner NPC in The Gate?
w: About one sigil per 2-3 hours of combat.

q: Fragments and sigils are tradeable (trade and AH)?
w: Like tools and blueprints; gives combat players something to sell.

q: Summon fights happen in 6 shared summon pits next to the boss arena with a short queue (no separate instance worlds)?
w: Instance worlds cost a lot of memory and CPU at 300 players.

q: A summon group is the summoner plus up to 4 players picked in the menu (the party once parties exist)?
w: Small groups keep summon bosses personal; picking in a menu works on Bedrock.

q: A failed summon (time runs out or the group dies or leaves) uses up the sigil; a crash, restart or staff stop gives it back in /box?
w: Failing is part of the fight; losing it to a bug is not (nothing lost by accident).

q: Everyone in the summon group with 10%+ damage gets the full loot, and summon money uses the boss's tier (not yours)?
w: Same rule as mini-bosses; late players can't farm low bosses for big money.

q: Summon boss leaderboards: fastest kill (group) and best damage in one fight, per boss per season?
w: Gives summon bosses their own damage board.

q: A Mystery Pet Egg opens into a rarity egg (Common 50, Uncommon 28, Rare 14, Epic 6, Legendary 2%) that hatches instantly into a random species?
w: Matches DESIGN 7; instant hatching follows 'no waiting'.

q: Pet eggs come from the Eclipse crate (8%), world and summon bosses (0.5-2%) and the Black Market (120 shards)?
w: Keeps pets rare and tied to the monthly crate and bosses.

q: Unhatched eggs are tradeable; a hatched pet is bound to its profile?
w: Eggs give a market; bound pets keep the 'nothing moves between profiles' rule simple and dupe-safe.

q: One active pet; its perk grows with level up to 3 / 5 / 8 / 11 / 15% by rarity at level 100, Epic and Legendary add +5 / +8% skill XP, all inside the existing bonus caps?
w: Felt but small; a pet never breaks the +300% sell cap or other caps.

q: 15 species tied to an activity (mine, forest, combat, farming, fishing, anywhere), every species in every rarity, Phoenix Chick Legendary only?
w: Each playstyle has pets worth hunting; loadouts can swap them.

q: Pet levels 1-100 from actions in its activity (Lv 100 after about 60 active hours), no XP from offline, AFK or grinders?
w: Fast start, slower later (your #61), and XP comes from playing.

q: Pets never fight or take damage; they only give perks?
w: Fighting pets would add lag and mess up boss damage shares.

q: Pets are small vanilla mobs following behind you; other players' pets are hidden in combat zones, summon pits and the boss arena, and /settings can hide all of them?
w: Works on Bedrock and a pet never blocks a hit meant for a mob.

q: Pets reset with the season like other profile progress; pet skins are account cosmetics and stay?
w: Same rule as tools and sets; skins are cosmetics (REVIEW C).

q: New commands /bosses (next boss, teleport, summon, leaderboards, last fights) and /pets, also as buttons in /menu?
w: Players check boss times and pets often; menus work on Bedrock.

q: Staff commands /boss start|stop|give and /pet give|view, all audited?
w: Staff need to test fights, end broken ones and fix lost items.

q: Once Phase 8 is live, the Wildwood outpost also unlocks when a member got Bronze or better in a world boss kill (islands that unlocked it already keep it)?
w: Matches DESIGN 3.7 'first world boss defeated' without taking anything away.

q: Soul Sand Valley biome gives summon fragments from player kills of spawner mobs on that outpost, max 5 per island per day?
w: Its 'boss key chance' needs something to drop; the daily cap stops AFK farms.

q: Sea creatures from Fishing 15 (1 in 25 catches, custom rod), they give Fishing and Combat XP and fishing-only drops?
w: Adds action to fishing using the same mob framework.

q: Lava fishing in Emberdeep lava and a spawn lava pond from Fishing 30 with a lava rod, 5 lava fish worth 1.2x?
w: A late fishing goal tied to the third outpost.

q: Fishing contests score points by fish rarity (1 / 2 / 5 / 15 / 50); top 3 get Blaze / Cinder / Ember keys, everyone with 10+ points a small crystal pouch?
w: Rarity points reward skill and luck, not only speed; small rewards for everyone keep people joining.

q: Balance rule: world, summon and mini-bosses together pay at most 6% of a regular player's income?
w: Keeps bosses as exciting bursts inside the ~15% event share, never a main income.
